status: Follow-up specified after the original results were examined, before calculating this extension; not a preregistration.
annual_nz: Published Year ended values and their own standard errors. Do not replace with monthly sums or sum standard errors.
annual_au: Sum exactly four consecutive quarterly exact-person counts in one vintage, labelled derived annual totals. No interpolated or cross-vintage inputs; no manufactured intervals.
periods: Same planned endpoints as original study: 2019Q1–2025Q1 paired; Jan 2019–Mar 2025 NZ; 2011Q1–2025Q1 AU extended. Require complete paths at all primary ages and reference18. Report excluded endpoints.
phase_interpretation: Reference-period calendar cohorts, not causal policy effects. 2020Q1 includes pre-restriction months. Annual endpoints are grouped by ending date; report phase-composition and fully-contained-year subsets separately. Reference publication may fall in a different phase.
metrics: Retain original definitions: signed/absolute/P90 revision scaled by reference gross flow; component-own-flow error; net2%/90% monitoring; components squared identity; quarter year-on-year direction; NZ annual interval revision coverage, width and proper95%interval score.
inference: Descriptive phase comparisons, no new significance tests. Full-sample annual pointwise stationary bootstrap 10000 draws with mean blocks6 quarters or18 months (4/8quarters or12/24months sensitivity). All paths retained. Calendar-year-end and all12 monthly endpoint offsets provide overlap sensitivities, not independent-sample guarantees.
reference_sensitivity: Use identical eligible endpoints for18vs24 comparison; disclose archive-history loss if 24month annual totals unavailable.
scope: No revision-risk model fitted in this task. Report whether evidence supports further benchmark development. Do not infer official CI miscalibration from coverage of a different estimand.
